backend_features_verified: Customer ID format: 2 uppercase letters from illaka_name + 4-digit sequential (DE0001, DE0002...)
Customer ID sequential: two consecutive KYCs with same illaka prefix get n and n+1
Customer ID persisted: GET /api/kycs/{id} returns correct customer_id
Auto-loan from KYC: loan_number = customer_id-L1 format
Standalone loan via POST /api/loans also gets loan_number
Second loan for same KYC gets loan_number L2 (sequential per customer)
Mobile uniqueness: second KYC with same phone returns 400 with mobile error message
No phone KYC: allowed (no false positive from mobile uniqueness check)
Collection sheet: returns {month, total, collected, illakas} structure
Collection sheet: each illaka has illaka_id, illaka_name, misals; each misal has rows with loan_db_id, client_name, emi_amount, emi_status, loan_number, customer_id
Collection sheet: sipahi can access their assigned loans
Loan list: newly created loans have loan_number field
KYC list: newly created KYCs have customer_id field
